title: Theo and the Machine
author: Mirabel Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Thackeray, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
